friendlypmc-knight-competition descripti: What's up fish? I see you working your way to the top, shooting, looting, reaping and tearing. But do you actually have what it takes to run with the big dogs? Let's find out. How about you and me teamup and do a couple of runs, a little competition, see who can stack the most. You in?
friendlypmc-knight-competition successMe:
You the man!... Neah, you are right, I am the man. But you did good rookie. Listen, from now on - give me a shout when you wanna teamup and let these tourists know what's what. The boys are still sketchy about you, but you and I will make them love you!
 (You now have Knight as your friend which you can request to join you in raids. Note that he will not spawn if you have Squad Spawn enabled and is only available for PMC)
friendlypmc-knight-competition failMessa: Come on man, I have faith in you. Let's do this, let's show them what you are made of.
friendlypmc-knight-competition note: Both you and Knight will have to survive the raid per each map
friendlypmc-knight-competition-1: Eliminate 5 targets on Woods while teamed up with Knight
friendlypmc-knight-competition-2: Eliminate 5 targets on Shoreline while teamed up with Knight
friendlypmc-knight-competition-3: Eliminate 5 targets on Lighthouse while teamed up with Knight
friendlypmc-knight-competition-fail: You and Knight must not die or leave the raid while the task is active (Status: KIA, Left the Action, MIA, Ran Through)
friendlypmc-knight-my-land description:
Yo! You know what I don't like? Roachers in my house. We go on a trip and these roaches immediately move in. Be a pal and lend a hand in cleaning them out.
 (In this quest, Knight must be the one to eliminate the targets)
friendlypmc-knight-my-land failMessageTe: What are you doing man? Is the job too much for you?
friendlypmc-knight-my-land-1: Help Knight eliminate 8 targets around the Scav Base on Customs
friendlypmc-knight-my-land-fail: Knight must not die while the task is active (Status: KIA, Left the Action, MIA, Ran Through)
friendlypmc-knight-thieves description: Of course they robbed us, but I am not worried about the little things their dirty hands took. However, they took something important and we need it back. It's Pipe's grenade launcher. That was no random steal, they specifically must've searched for it and grabbed it. And they knew where it was. There is no point in looking for who took it, it's already dropped off by now. What we need to find out is who was the client that set it up as I do not see these guys just deciding on their own to do this. I got my suspects and I know where their favorite drop off points are. Let's get it back, you down?
friendlypmc-knight-thieves successMessag: Thanks brother! So that's where you found it? That means we got our client and we will have to talk with him about taking another man's property.
friendlypmc-knight-thieves failMessageTe: Come on man, don't let me down!
friendlypmc-knight-thieves-1: Look for BigPipe's grenade launcher room MP21 of the Repair Center workshop, in Reserve.
friendlypmc-knight-thieves-2: Look for BigPipe's grenade launcher in the Hive hookah lounge, in Streets of Tarkov.
friendlypmc-knight-payback01 description: Mister Robocop decided to upgrade and considered it within his right to just take what's ours without even asking first. Well, they say no one is above the law so it's time to remind him of that. Kollontay is the client and our foot is about to do some thieving of its own into his mouth!
friendlypmc-knight-payback01 successMess:
Justice served! Nice work man, this will go a long way with Pipe.
(You now have BigPipe as your friend which you can request to join you in raids. Note that he will not spawn if you have Squad Spawn enabled and is only available for PMC)
